title.en: RG 1 TOWN AND COUNTRY PLANNING COMPOSITION OF OFFENCES REGULATIONS

text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Town and Country Planning (Composition of Offences) Regulations.
Any offence under section 23 may be compounded by the Planning Authority or any person authorised in writing in that behalf by the Planning Authority under section 58(1).

heading.en: Form and manner of offer to compound

text.en: An offer to compound shall be in such form and manner as the Planning Authority may determine.

(1) When an offer to compound any offence is made and accepted, payment for it shall be made in cash, at the place where the offer was made or at the office as specified by the Planning Authority or any person authorised by the Planning Authority in the offer to compound.

(2) Payment for the compound shall be made within 7 days from the date the offer was made.
When payment is made in accordance with regulation 4(1), a receipt shall be issued for such payment to the person to whom the offer to compound was made.

On the payment of such sum of money for the offer to compound, no further proceedings shall be taken against the person who has been reasonably suspected of having committed an offence. 6 CAP. 248, Rg 1 Town and Country Planning Issue of summons

Any person who —

(a) fails to appear at the office as specified by the Planning Authority or any person authorised by the Planning Authority in the offer to compound;

(b) fails to make payment within the period referred to in regulation 4(2); or

(c) furnishes any information which is false or misleading, shall be issued with a summons.
